const cliente = flow.get('exclusao_ctx');
const nome = cliente.nome;
const script = `
import subprocess, json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

NOME = ${JSON.stringify(nome)}
STACK = Path('/opt/scadalts/stack')
stamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')
BACKUP_DIR = Path(f'/opt/_backups_pre_reorg/excluido-{NOME}-{stamp}')
BACKUP_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

subprocess.run(f'docker exec mysql mysqldump -uroot -p__MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD__ scadalts_{NOME} > {BACKUP_DIR}/scadalts_{NOME}.sql', shell=True, check=False)
subprocess.run(f'tar -czf {BACKUP_DIR}/client-{NOME}.tar.gz -C {STACK}/clients {NOME}', shell=True, check=False)
subprocess.run(f'docker stop stack-scadalts-{NOME}-1', shell=True, check=False)
subprocess.run(f'docker rm stack-scadalts-{NOME}-1', shell=True, check=False)
subprocess.run(f'''docker exec mysql mysql -uroot -p__MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD__ -e \"DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS scadalts_{NOME}; DROP USER IF EXISTS 'scadalts_{NOME}'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;\"''', shell=True, check=False)
subprocess.run(f'rm -rf {STACK}/clients/{NOME}', shell=True, check=False)

import yaml
with open(STACK / 'docker-compose.yml') as f:
    d = yaml.safe_load(f)
d['services'].pop(f'scadalts-{NOME}', None)
with open(STACK / 'docker-compose.yml', 'w') as f:
    yaml.dump(d, f, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False)

inativo = {'nome': NOME, 'desligado_em': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'backup': str(BACKUP_DIR)}
with open(STACK / 'clients_inactive.jsonl', 'a') as f:
    f.write(json.dumps(inativo) + chr(10))

reg_path = STACK / 'clients_registry.jsonl'
if reg_path.exists():
    linhas = reg_path.read_text().splitlines()
    restantes = [l for l in linhas if json.loads(l).get('nome') != NOME] if linhas else []
    reg_path.write_text(chr(10).join(restantes) + (chr(10) if restantes else ''))

print('EXCLUSAO_OK')
`;
const b64 = Buffer.from(script, 'utf8').toString('base64');
msg.payload = `echo ${b64} | base64 -d | python3 -`;
const proc = { stepUpdates: [{key:'ingress', state:'done'}, {key:'purga', state:'running'}] };
return [msg, proc];
